nodes.text: Nobody takes my boat who has not done the house in its turn. Ring the bell, so the far bank knows. Then the store, with this key. Then my chest. Then the three buttons on the wall, and the bolt on the shed gate.
Because people press things. A thing that moves for anybody gets moved by everybody. In this house a thing moves when its turn comes, and not before.
The house is done, and done in its turn. Three buttons on the wall, one pin each. Then draw the bolt, and the boat is yours till sundown.
